appraisal_events.evidence: Avec la « sensibilité » prétendue des nerveux grandit leur égoïsme ; ils ne peuvent supporter de la part des autres l'exhibition des malaises... si je souffrais [Françoise] détournait la tête pour que je n'eusse pas le plaisir de voir ma souffrance plainte, même remarquée.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator generalizes from Françoise's behavior to expose a self-protective core beneath her supposed sensitivity: she turns away from the narrator's sadness so as not to grant him the comfort of being noticed, jealously guarding her own suffering's primacy.

status_effects.explanation: Françoise is locally diminished as the narrator's generalization exposes her sympathy as inflected by self-protective egoism rather than pure feeling.
